evidence.note: Systematically ablates which section (prompt, CoT, answer) of a reasoning-distillation training sequence carries the useful supervisory signal and how much of the CoT is needed, finding CoT-inclusive supervision is essential while training on only the first 50% of tokens retains ~91% of full-sequence accuracy at roughly half the training time, memory, and FLOPs.
evidence.title: Distilling the Essence: Efficient Reasoning Distillation via Sequence Truncation
